FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_units DESC, p.name ASC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 4;

       COUNT(o.id) AS cancelled_order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.id

WHERE c.country = 'SWE'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(merchandise_minor) / 100.0, 2) AS average_merchandise_value_dollars
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY o.id
) AS canceled_orders;

SELECT p.category,
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'DEU'
  AND o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        category,
        revenue_minor,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month, category, revenue_minor / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

    'audio_gear', 'home_decor', 'kids_toys'
  )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) = 6;

WITH merchandise AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT c.name AS customer_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(m.total_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) / 100.0 AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN merchandise AS m ON m.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(m.total_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refund_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.revenue_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_minor, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) / 100.0 AS net_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at)
ORDER BY month;

    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS below_list_pct

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        category,
        revenue_minor,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month, category, revenue_minor / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(COALESCE(i.merchandise_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) / 100.0 AS total_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(i.merchandise_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refund_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.revenue_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_minor, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) / 100.0 AS net_amount_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at)
ORDER BY month;

    p.name AS product_name,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING 100 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 45 * COUNT(*);

    c.name AS customer_name,
    julianday(date(MIN(o.placed_at))) - julianday(date(c.signup_date)) AS days_to_first_order
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment = 'reseller_partner'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.signup_date
ORDER BY days_to_first_order, c.name, c.id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(merchandise_minor) / 100.0, 2) AS avg_merchandise_dollars
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY o.id
);

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month, category, revenue_minor / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

WITH merchandise AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT c.name AS customer_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(m.merchandise_minor, 0) + o.shipping_minor) / 100.0 AS total_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN merchandise AS m ON m.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_dollars DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refund_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.revenue_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_minor, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) / 100.0 AS net_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at)
ORDER BY month;

    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS below_list_pct

SELECT c.name,
       CAST(JULIANDAY(DATE(MIN(o.placed_at))) - JULIANDAY(DATE(c.signup_date)) AS INTEGER) AS days_to_first_order
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment = 'reseller_partner'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.signup_date
ORDER BY days_to_first_order ASC, c.name ASC;
